title: Pure Marincess
summary: The pure Marincess WATER Cyberse Link-climbing build with the 2025 Trickstar Aqua Angel and generic staples. A single starter climbs through Link-1, Link-2, and Link-3 Marincess monsters into Link-4 Marincess Aqua Argonaut equipped with three Links under Marincess Battle Ocean.

summary.title: Starters
points: Marincess Blue Tang sends a Marincess monster from the Deck to the GY on summon, and excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck for a Marincess card when used as WATER Link Material.
Marincess Sea Horse Special Summons itself from the hand to a zone a Marincess Link points to, and banishes itself from the GY to summon a WATER monster from your hand.
Marincess Springirl banishes a Marincess monster from your GY to Special Summon itself, while Marincess Pascalus Special Summons a Marincess from your hand in Defense Position.

summary.title: Opening: 1-Card Blue Tang or Sea Horse into Aqua Argonaut
steps: Normal Summon Marincess Blue Tang to send Marincess Sea Horse (or Sleepy Maiden) to the GY, then Link Summon Marincess Blue Slug; Blue Slug recovers Sea Horse while Blue Tang excavates 3.
Special Summon Sea Horse to Blue Slug's arrow and Link Summon Marincess Sea Angel to search Marincess Battle Ocean or Marincess Dive.
Link Summon Marincess Coral Anemone, revive a WATER monster to its arrow, and Link Summon Marincess Coral Triangle to search Marincess Wave.

Activate Marincess Battle Ocean and Link Summon Marincess Aqua Argonaut (or route through Marincess Crystal Heart first so Argonaut is unaffected by opponent's card effects), equipping three Marincess Links from the GY.

summary.title: Battle Ocean & Trickstar Aqua Angel
summary.text: When you Link Summon a Marincess monster to the Extra Monster Zone, Marincess Battle Ocean equips up to 3 Marincess Link Monsters with different names from your GY to it, granting +600 ATK per equip on top of a +2000 ATK base boost. If that monster was Link Summoned using Marincess Crystal Heart, Battle Ocean makes it unaffected by your opponent's card effects. Trickstar Aqua Angel is always treated as a Marincess card, Special Summons itself from the hand or GY once per Duel, and prevents linked monsters pointing to it from being destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Marincess Aqua Argonaut bounces a WATER monster you control and an opponent's card, and negates an opponent's Spell/Trap effect on their turn by Special Summoning one of its equipped Marincess Links.
Marincess Great Bubble Reef draws a card each Standby Phase by banishing a WATER monster and gains 600 ATK whenever a monster is banished.
Blue Slug, Coral Anemone, Coral Triangle, and Marbled Rock lock you into WATER summons for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Marincess Wave negates an opposing face-up monster's effects and makes all face-up WATER monsters you control unaffected by opponent's card effects for the turn; if you control a Link-3 or higher Marincess, you can activate it from your hand.
Marincess Dive revives a non-Link Marincess from the GY, or Special Summons any Marincess directly from the Deck while Marincess Battle Ocean is in your Field Zone.
Marincess Circulation returns a WATER Link to the Extra Deck to Link Summon a same-rating Marincess Link from the Extra Deck (and activates from the hand with a Link-3+).

main: Marincess Blue Tang
Starter: mills a Marincess; as Link Material, digs three for a Marincess card.
Marincess Sea Horse
Summons itself into a Marincess Link's zone; from the GY, summons another WATER.
Marincess Springirl
Banishes a Marincess to summon itself; mills and burns as Link Material.
Marincess Pascalus
Summons another Marincess from the hand; recovers a Marincess Spell/Trap.
Trickstar Aqua Angel
Newest, treated as Marincess: summons itself once per Duel; protects linked monsters in battle.
Marincess Sleepy Maiden
Summons itself and protects a Marincess card; equips a Link from the GY.
Marincess Basilalima
Searches a Marincess Trap; protects your monsters from the GY.
Marincess Mandarin
Summons itself into a Link's zone from the hand or GY.
Marincess Crown Tail
Hand trap for battle: halves or stops battle damage.
Marincess Battle Ocean
Field Spell: equips spare Marincess Links for ATK; protects Crystal Heart Links.
Marincess Dive
Revives a Marincess, or summons one from the Deck with Battle Ocean up.
Marincess Wave
Negates a monster and makes yours unaffected; from the hand with a Link-3.
Marincess Circulation
Swaps a WATER Link for a Marincess Link of the same rating on either turn.
Marincess Bubble Ring
Stops an attack and summons Crystal Heart.
extra: Link-4 boss: bounces a card and negates Spells/Traps on their turn.
Link-4: draws each Standby Phase and summons a banished Marincess.
Link-4: swaps in an equipped Marincess in battle; revives a Link when destroyed.
Link-3: recovers a Marincess card; stops a battle.
Link-3: searches a Marincess Trap; revives Links.
Link-2: revives a small WATER; recovers a Marincess card when it leaves.
Link-2: unaffected by monster effects in the Extra Monster Zone.
Link-1: recovers a Marincess from the GY.
